cases.title: Durable conversation binding
cases.expect: one PostgreSQL binding maps WEBCHAT externalConversationId to one Appointment workflowId

cases.title: Adapter restart recovery
cases.expect: after WebChat process restart the externalConversationId resolves to the same workflowId from PostgreSQL

cases.title: Exact start replay
cases.expect: same inbound identity and same canonical START material returns the same workflowId with one logical Workflow start

cases.title: Exact update replay
cases.expect: same inbound identity and same canonical update material returns the recorded result without a second logical Workflow update

cases.title: Material conflict
cases.expect: same business/channel/externalMessageId with different canonical material returns CHANNEL_EVENT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT

cases.title: Conflict is mutation free
cases.expect: Workflow projection before and after conflicting material is unchanged

cases.title: Browser duplicate-submit safety
cases.expect: duplicate transport submission does not produce duplicate Customer/Appointment effects

cases.title: Hardened complete Appointment
cases.expect: the complete explicit channel action sequence reaches COMPLETED/CREATED with issues=[]

cases.title: C1A visibility retained
cases.expect: Workflow inspector and channel response expose the same real Temporal phase, nextAction and 12-step projection

cases.title: Provider-independent execution core
cases.expect: adapter registry owns provider composition; no Agent/MCP/provider business branch is introduced

cases.title: Business-scoped event identity
cases.expect: the same externalMessageId can be used independently in two different business scopes without collision

cases.title: Durable terminal event response
cases.expect: APPLIED or REJECTED event terminal response is stored and returned on exact replay
